detailedNarrative: CASE007 (FIR/KAROLBAGH/2025/0007) — Cyber Fraud (Online Investment Scam) registered at PS Karol Bagh, New Delhi. Incident recorded on 2025-02-12 19:51 at Laxmi Nagar Residential, Delhi. FIR records 1 accused (Vivek Sharma P00029) and 3 named persons in total. 867 records across 5 sources; 13 transactions flagged for review. Money-flow records show funds received and forwarded within minutes (e.g. EVD-TXN001089 → EVD-TXN001095, 42.0 min), a pattern that can indicate layering and requires verification. 6 transfers from P00029 to P00029 each fell just below ₹50,000 (total ₹272,456). Account SBIN-22901476797 received funds from 4 different individuals within 14 days. Communication between P00009 and P00029 spiked to 4 contacts within 3 hours on 2025-02-12. Note: P00029 has a record 407.8 km from the incident location 67 min after the incident (EVD-LOC002104), which may be exculpatory and needs verification.
